messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync from the RCA — can we confirm who is taking which postmortem actions and realistic due dates? Need to lock this down for the customer update tomorrow.
Liam Chen: I can own the rollback automation (action 2). Planning to finish the script + tests by Wed EOD.
Samir Gupta: I'll take the alert tuning and runbook update (action 4). Blocking on prometheus access. @Diana Park can you grant the service account?
Diana Park: Yep, granting namespace perms now. Will follow up in 2h once RBAC changes land.
Eva Romero: I'll pick up the incident retrospective writeup and the customer-facing summary (action 1). Can someone drop the exact SLA-impact wording?
Maya Patel: Copy: "We experienced latency spikes impacting inference throughput between 15:23–15:45 UTC; fallback routing triggered automatically; no data loss." Use that in the summary.
Samir Gupta: Thanks — noted. @OpsBot did the prometheus role change go through?
OpsBot: RBAC change applied to svcacct/prom-monitor in cluster-prod at 11:12 UTC.
Samir Gupta: Great, I'll start work now. ETA for alert tuning: Thu noon PT.
Tomasz Nowak: Heads-up — the rollback script will need the hotfix image build from eng-releases. @Liam Chen can you coordinate the PR and tag?
Liam Chen: Will open PR today and request eng-releases review. Tagging release-candidate when tests pass. Expected PR merge by Tue.
Diana Park: One dependency: infra needs to resize a disk for the rollback job logs. Eng-infra says they can do it Thu morning. That might push rollback script validation to Thu EOD.
Maya Patel: Ok adjust dates accordingly. Eva, if customer update is tomorrow morning we'll provide mitigations and a tentative timeline for full remediation (Thu EOD).
Eva Romero: Fine — I'll phrase it as: mitigation in place, full fix targeted by Thu EOD, we'll update if anything changes.
Samir Gupta: Quick question on acceptance criteria for alert tuning: reduce false positives from 6/day to <=1/day and add a runbook link. Is that correct?
Maya Patel: Yes — reduce noise and include runbook link + rollback trigger steps.
Liam Chen: After rollback script PR merges I'll add a small integration test that runs in a sandbox namespace and posts results to CI.
Tomasz Nowak: Also need a short postmortem checklist item for security to review access changes. @Diana Park can you loop in security?
Diana Park: On it, adding @security-team to the RCA doc and assigning a review with a 48h SLAT.
OpsBot: Deploy pipeline: branch "rollback/automate-1890" build succeeded at 13:07 UTC, 3/3 CI checks passed.
Maya Patel: Great. Can everyone confirm by EOD today if their dates still hold? We'll freeze the customer note at 09:00 UTC tomorrow.
Liam Chen: Confirmed (Wed EOD -> may shift to Thu EOD if infra disk delay persists).
Samir Gupta: Confirmed (Thu noon PT).
Diana Park: Confirmed (will update security and RBAC status).
Eva Romero: Confirmed (will circulate draft before 09:00 UTC).
Maya Patel: Thanks — I'll compile and post the final action table in the RCA doc. If anything slips, flag here immediately. :thumbsup:
